sections.headline: Modern Lifestyles Can Disrupt Your Body's Natural Balance
sections.body: Sitting for long stretches — on planes, trains, or at a desk — can slow the body's natural fluid and urinary rhythms. Add in processed foods, stress, and fewer opportunities to move, and it becomes harder for the body to stay in balance. Many people aren't getting enough natural plant compounds from diet alone, leaving the system less resilient when it needs to perform most.
bullets: Processed foods and stress burden natural balance
Long periods of sitting slow fluid regulation
Dietary gaps leave the body without key supportive compounds

sections.headline: The Ancient Seed Backed by Centuries of Use
sections.body: Often called "Nature's Bladder Guardian," pumpkin seed oil has been trusted for generations to support urinary comfort, hormonal balance, and natural resilience. Its key compounds — beta-sitosterol and zinc — are known to support healthy urinary flow and maintain hormonal balance. With Lumora, you're tapping into one of nature's most studied seed-based allies for daily balance and comfort.
bullets: Beta-sitosterol supports urinary comfort and hormonal balance
Zinc promotes healthy cellular function and resilience
Omega 3-6-9 fatty acids support a healthy inflammatory response

sections.headline: Feel Lighter, Calmer, and More Comfortable — Wherever You Are
sections.body: Long travel days and hours of sitting can lead to urinary urgency, low energy, and that heavy, uncomfortable feeling. Lumora Pumpkin Seed Oil supports healthy fluid balance, calm bladder function, and steady energy — so your body feels more at ease whether you're mid-flight, on a long drive, or powering through a demanding day at your desk.
bullets: Supports calm bladder comfort during low-movement periods
Helps maintain steady energy and vitality
Promotes a comfortable, lighter-feeling body from within

sections.headline: One Ingredient. Extensive Natural Support.
sections.body: Lumora keeps it simple — featuring cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil with saw palmetto. No fillers, no artificial additives, no harsh cleansers. Just pure, plant-based support. Key natural compounds include beta-sitosterol for urinary comfort, zinc for healthy cellular function, and omega 3-6-9 fatty acids for a healthy inflammatory response. Clean. Traceable. Effective.
bullets: Beta-Sitosterol — urinary comfort & hormonal balance support
Zinc — healthy cellular function & hair follicle strength
Omega 3-6-9 Fatty Acids — natural inflammatory response support

sections.headline: You Travel, Sit for Hours, and Want to Feel Your Best
sections.body: Lumora Pumpkin Seed Oil is ideal for frequent flyers, long-distance commuters, and anyone who spends hours seated and wants to support their body from within. It's also a great fit for health-conscious adults seeking natural kidney and bladder wellness, or anyone who wants steady energy, comfort, and resilience without stimulants or synthetic additives.

Anyone wanting daily comfort, balance, and steady energy

faqs.question: How do I take Lumora Pumpkin Seed Oil?
faqs.answer: Take 2 softgels daily with food. For additional support, you may take up to 3 softgels per day as needed. Consistent daily use delivers the best results.

faqs.question: Is Lumora safe to take with my current medications?
faqs.answer: Lumora is formulated with natural, plant-based ingredients. If you take medications or have existing health concerns, consult your healthcare provider before starting any new supplement.

faqs.question: How long before I notice results?
faqs.answer: Many customers notice calmer urinary function and steadier energy within the first few days or weeks. Long-term daily use provides the best cumulative support.

faqs.question: Can I buy Lumora in stores?
faqs.answer: Currently, Lumora Pumpkin Seed Oil Softgels are available exclusively online. This ensures the highest quality, freshness, and best pricing for every customer.

faqs.question: How many servings are in each pouch?
faqs.answer: Each pouch contains 180 softgels — a 2 to 3 month supply depending on daily use — of cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil with saw palmetto.

faqs.question: Is Lumora a good fit for travel?
faqs.answer: Yes — Lumora's easy-to-take softgels are designed for daily use at home or on the go, making them a simple addition to any travel wellness routine.
